faq.a: It's the medical name for pain in and around the coccyx (tailbone). It usually gets worse when sitting, especially when leaning back, and when standing up after sitting.

faq.q: What is Internal Manipulation, and does it hurt?
faq.a: It's a hands-on, non-surgical technique that frees up the tight ligaments and muscles attached to the coccyx and restores its alignment and movement. It is quick and done with full consent and privacy. Patients commonly report it's far less uncomfortable than they expected.

faq.q: How many sessions will I need?
faq.a: It depends on your diagnosis, how long you've had the pain and your general health. Some people need very few visits, and others need a short course. We reassess your progress at every visit.

A consultation costs ₹800, at the clinic or online by video. A follow-up within 7 days costs ₹500. You pay at the clinic by cash, UPI or card. For an online consultation we tell you how to pay by UPI when we confirm the time. The cancellation and refund rules are on the [terms, fees and refunds](/policies.html) page.

faq.q: What should I bring to my appointment?
faq.a: A short note of how and when the pain started, any past injuries or operations, and a list of the medicines you take. Wear comfortable clothing.

faq.q: Do I need a referral from a doctor?
faq.a: No. You can book directly with us on the [contact page](/book), by phone or on WhatsApp.
Yes. A female doctor, trained by Dr Rajveer Singh, sees patients at the New Delhi clinic. Just tell us when you call or message to book.

faq.q: I live outside India. Can you help?
faq.a: Yes. Many of our patients travel from abroad, including from the Middle East. Start with an online consultation and we'll help you plan the visit.

faq.q: Can the doctor come to us?
faq.a: Yes. On request, the specialist can travel to your city or country and treat you there, for one patient or a group. Travel, accommodation and food are covered by you, along with the treatment fee. Please ask at least 7 days ahead by phone or WhatsApp so we can plan the visit.

faq.q: How do I cancel or reschedule?
faq.a: Call or WhatsApp us on [+91 98866 88323](tel:+919886688323) and we'll move or cancel it for you. The refund rules are on the [terms, fees and refunds](/policies.html) page.
